content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: the Apply button on sales invoice:new gives no recorded response after a click, so users click it again at the same spot. In all three sessions, five clicks on Apply (279, 283, 287, 290, 294 in Sabc305a8; 279, 284, 287, 290, 294 in S3c997a45; 289, 294, 298, 301, 305 in S3edf7344) occur within about 1 s with no navigation, overlay, dialog, or error event in between.", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new screen, change the Apply button (the button at about x 1375\u20131400, y 850\u2013875, in the Taxes Section) so that a first click immediately disables it and shows a pending state until the apply action completes, and show a visible confirmation or updated taxes totals when it finishes.", "cited_event_ids": ["279", "283", "287", "290", "294", "284", "289", "298", "301", "305", "296:302", "291:293"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The events do not record DOM or state changes, so whether Apply updated anything after the clicks is not shown.", "What Apply does and whether the repeated clicks are needed for it to work is not shown.", "The reason users clicked again (for example, whether they expected a result) is not shown and is not inferred here.", "The 578\u2013581 dropped pointer samples per session may hide movement or hover events near the button.", "Coverage is empty for this insight, so no overlay-based explanation can be checked."]}
